literal.prompt: Как называется покрытие для кисти с отдельными секциями для каждого пальца и большого пальца?

literalGroups.primaryGround: MW glove defines a covering for the hand with separate sections for the fingers and thumb (L46). MW defines a mitten as a hand/wrist covering with a separate section for the thumb only (L38), a fingerless item as having no fingers (fingerless L38), and a muff as a warm tubular hand covering (muff L42); only the glove definition has separate sections for each digit.
literalGroups.locator: glove L31-L50; mitten L31-L42; fingerless L31-L38; muff L31-L48

literalGroups.literal: Перчатка закрывает кисть и имеет отдельные секции для пальцев и большого пальца. У варежки отдельное отделение есть только для большого пальца, а муфта — тёплое трубчатое покрытие для рук. Перчатка без пальцев оставляет пальцы открытыми.
literalGroups.primaryGround: MW glove L46 supports the correct definition and additional thumb section; MW mitten L38 distinguishes the mitten; MW muff L42 supports the tubular covering; MW fingerless L38 supports the open-finger contrast.
literalGroups.locator: glove L46; mitten L38; fingerless L38; muff L42

literalGroups.literal: У варежки отдельная секция предусмотрена только для большого пальца.
literalGroups.primaryGround: MW mitten defines the hand/wrist covering as having a separate section for the thumb only (L38).

literalGroups.literal: Перчатка нередко закрывает часть руки выше кисти.
literalGroups.primaryGround: MW glove says gloves often extend partway up the arm (L46); this is an additional fact about the correct item beyond prompt and key.

literalGroups.literal: Fingerless означает «без пальцев»: такая перчатка оставляет пальцы открытыми.
literalGroups.primaryGround: MW defines fingerless as “having no fingers” (L38). Applied to a glove, the term distinguishes the fingerless form, whose fingers remain uncovered; the glove page separately establishes ordinary finger sections.

literalGroups.literal: Муфта — тёплый трубчатый чехол для рук.
literalGroups.primaryGround: MW defines muff as a warm tubular covering for the hands (L42).

absoluteDifficulty.grounds: Recognizing an ordinary glove by separately covered fingers is familiar to a broad adult audience. The alternatives are related handwear and hand coverings—mitten, fingerless glove, and muff—so the player must distinguish their design rather than discard unrelated neck/waist accessories.
